title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Eligibility Policy: Electronic Verification, Re-Verification and Resubmission of Member Details
content:
Before a coverage held under **Insurance Coverage & Claims** is billed, it must be verified electronically.

## Clauses

1. **Member details.** The member ID must match the payer class's member identifier format, and the patient's relationship to the subscriber must be one of the relationships the payer class allows; a child dependent is covered only through the payer class's dependent age. Member details are taken exactly as printed on the patient's card; an agent never infers or reformats a member ID.
2. **Turnaround and outcome.** A verification is completed within the payer class's verification turnaround in business days. A response of *active coverage* sets the coverage active; *member not found* or *inactive coverage* sets it inactive. A coverage still unverified after the payer class's pending-verification limit in business days is set inactive.
3. **Re-verification.** A coverage whose last verified date is more than the payer class's re-verification span in calendar days before a date of service is re-verified before that order's claim is filed; a re-verification returning *inactive coverage* sets the coverage inactive.
4. **Resubmission window.** Corrected member details can be resubmitted on the same coverage only while it is inactive and no more than the payer class's resubmission period in calendar days has passed since it was set inactive.

## Clause 4 in detail

- **Clock start.** The date the coverage was set inactive, as shown by the date of the failed verification on the coverage record. The record governs, not the caller's recollection, and the coverage concerned is the coverage record being resubmitted.
- **Counting.** The window counts calendar days from the date of the failed verification as day 0, the last day included; after it, the corrected details are added as a new coverage.
- **Length.** The payer class's resubmission period, 60 calendar days for every payer class.
- **State.** The coverage must be inactive at the time of resubmission.

| Failed verification (day 0) | Resubmission date | Day count | Same record? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 March 2026 (hypothetical) | 1 May 2026 | 60 | Yes — the last day is included |
| 2 March 2026 (hypothetical) | 2 May 2026 | 61 | No — the corrected details are added as a new coverage |

## Points of judgement

- *The coverage is active and the patient has a new card number.* Clause 4 allows resubmission only while the coverage is inactive.
- *The verification failed for member not found.* The coverage is inactive from that date, and that date is day 0 of the window.
